question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: The end of the autobahn
The end of the clearway for motor vehicles only
Temporary closure of the autobahn

correct_answers.text: The end of the autobahn

comment: This traffic sign is at the end of the motorway.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: The end of the clearway for motor vehicles only
The end of the autobahn
Motor vehicles prohibited

correct_answers.text: The end of the clearway for motor vehicles only

comment: This traffic sign is placed at the end of a highway. It means: From here on the advisory speed limit no longer applies. It does not indicate a ban on motor vehicles.

question_text: What do such traffic signs indicate?

options.text: The number of an autobahn
The distance to the next petrol station
The number of a European road

correct_answers.text: The number of an autobahn

comment: A white number on a blue background with a white outline indicates the number of the motorway you are currently on.

question_text: What does the figure "26" indicate in this traffic sign?

options.text: Autobahn exit number 26
The A 26
The distance from the exit to Düsseldorf-Benrath

correct_answers.text: Autobahn exit number 26

comment: All motorway exits are numbered for better orientation. As a car driver, you can recognize the freeway exit ramp by the number 26. On road maps, in road atlases and in the common navigation devices, these numbers can also be found again.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A diversion for autobahn traffic when required
An underground station
Federal road (Bundesstrasse) 22

correct_answers.text: A diversion for autobahn traffic when required

comment: This traffic sign refers to a detour for freeway traffic. It is set up in the event of a traffic jam, for example. If the car driver follows the detour, he/she returns to the freeway.

question_text: What applies from this traffic sign onwards?

options.text: Maximum permissible speed 50 km/h
Free choice of marked driving lanes for motor vehicles with a permissible total mass up to 3.5 t
Free choice of marked driving lanes for all motor vehicles

correct_answers.text: Maximum permissible speed 50 km/h
Free choice of marked driving lanes for motor vehicles with a permissible total mass up to 3.5 t

comment: This traffic sign is subject to regulations that apply to traffic within built-up areas. This includes limiting the maximum speed to 50 km/h. Free choice of lanes applies only to vehicles up to 3.5 t permissible maximum mass. Vehicles with more than 3.5 t drive on the right.

question_text: What applies when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: - choose whatever lane I wish for my direction of travel
- drive more quickly in the right-hand lane than vehicles travelling in the left-hand lane
- drive faster than 50 km/h because this is a multi-lane carriageway

correct_answers.text: - choose whatever lane I wish for my direction of travel
- drive more quickly in the right-hand lane than vehicles travelling in the left-hand lane

comment: In towns, you are allowed to deviate from the requirement to drive on the right, i.e. you are free to choose your lane on multi-lane roads. On two-lane roads in towns, vehicles in the right lane may also drive faster than vehicles in the left lane, but you are still not allowed to drive faster than 50 km/h in towns.

question_text: What applies from this traffic sign onwards?

options.text: You may not sound your horn to signal your intention to overtake
Parking cars may be safely marked with parking light
You may drive with parking light in the darkness

correct_answers.text: You may not sound your horn to signal your intention to overtake
Parking cars may be safely marked with parking light

comment: Car drivers recognize from this traffic sign that the regulations for traffic within closed villages apply. You must not announce overtaking maneuvers by honking, as this is only allowed outside closed villages. In general, it is forbidden to drive with parking lights. Parking cars may be secured with the parking light.

question_text: How are vehicles with a permissible total mass up to 2.8 t allowed to be parked here?

options.text: The car as shown in the picture
The caravan as shown in the picture
Small cars also diagonally to the driving direction

correct_answers.text: The car as shown in the picture
The caravan as shown in the picture

comment: This traffic sign signals to the vehicle driver that vehicles up to 2.8 t of permissible total mass may only be parked in accordance with the illustration. However, smaller cars also have to comply with these regulations as well.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: - hydrogen filling station
- natural gas fuel station
- auto gas filling station

correct_answers.text: - hydrogen filling station

comment: The square traffic sign with a blue border indicates that there is a refuel possibility for hydrogen-powered vehicles in the immediate vicinity. These cars are still relatively expensive, but are considered the vehicles of the future.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: - natural gas fuel station
- hydrogen filling station
- auto gas filling station

correct_answers.text: - natural gas fuel station

comment: This traffic sign points out a natural gas filling station where drivers can refuel their natural gas-powered vehicle. The abbreviation CNG stands for the term compressed natural gas.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: - auto gas filling station
- natural gas fuel station
- hydrogen filling station

correct_answers.text: - auto gas filling station

comment: The inscription LPG on the square traffic sign is an abbreviation for Liquefied Petroleum Gas. This traffic sign signals to the car driver that there is an LPG station.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A charging station for electric vehicles
A danger of explosion at a filling station through electric devices
A facility for charging mobile telephones

correct_answers.text: A charging station for electric vehicles

comment: You will see a plug with cable on the sign. It shows you a nearby charging station for electric vehicles such as electric cars, e-bikes or electric scooters. There you can charge your powered vehicle.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A carpark with connections to public transport ("Park + Ride")
A filling station with carwash ("Care + Clean")
A car hire centre with repair workshop ("Breakdown service + Repair")

correct_answers.text: A carpark with connections to public transport ("Park + Ride")

comment: The traffic sign P + R on a blue background stands for "Park and Ride". It identifies a parking lot with public transport connection. The parking lot is continuous or temporary.

question_text: You are driving a toll-chargeable truck and are approaching the displayed traffic sign. What should you do?

options.text: I check the on-board-unit (OBU), to see if the number of axles is set correctly
I may continue driving without an on-board-unit (OBU), only if a toll was paid for using the route
I pay the toll at the toll station upon leaving the toll route

correct_answers.text: I check the on-board-unit (OBU), to see if the number of axles is set correctly
I may continue driving without an on-board-unit (OBU), only if a toll was paid for using the route

comment: You can only continue if the toll was paid for using the route and you should check whether it is correctly set the correct number of axles here without on-board unit (OBU). If not, ask me correctly.

question_text: What is correct in this situation?

options.text: - allowed to drive on the advisory bike lane after I have ruled out any risk to cyclists by carefully observing the road traffic situation
- allowed to drive on the advisory bike lane only until I am past the truck
- not allowed to drive on the advisory bike lane

correct_answers.text: - allowed to drive on the advisory bike lane after I have ruled out any risk to cyclists by carefully observing the road traffic situation
- allowed to drive on the advisory bike lane only until I am past the truck

comment: Driving a protective strip continuously is not permitted. Protective strips have a dashed mark and can be driven by car if necessary, especially to avoid oncoming traffic. But you can only do that if bicycle traffic is not endangered.

question_text: Which document allows you to park here?

options.text: My EU parking card for people with severe disabilities
The EU parking card of a severely disabled person whom I am transporting
My residential parking permit

correct_answers.text: My EU parking card for people with severe disabilities
The EU parking card of a severely disabled person whom I am transporting

comment: You are allowed to park in the parking lot with this sign if you yourself have an EU parking permit for severely disabled people or if you are transporting a person with an EU parking permit for severely disabled people.
